transaction.answer: The item is a specific military good listed in GKV Anhang 3 (ML7). Exporting it requires a SECO licence (GKV Art. 3 Abs. 1). Australia is listed in GKV Anhang 7, so the export may proceed without an individual licence if the exporter holds an ordentliche Generalexportbewilligung (OGB) under GKV Art. 12 Abs. 1 that covers this item and destination; otherwise an individual licence must be obtained. The OGB does not lift the licence requirement of Art. 3 Abs. 1, it substitutes for an individual licence. SECO may at any time require information on the end-destination of goods shipped under a general licence (GKV Art. 18 Abs. 2). SECO examines the application under the refusal grounds of GKV Art. 6 / GKG Art. 6. For specific military goods, licences are also refused where the UN or partner states prohibit the export (GKG Art. 6 Abs. 2).
